page.notes: A small mark (asterisk-like) stands beside "Receptis arbitris" in the right column; it is not clearly a printed reference and is not transcribed. Column heads "M.", "N.", "O.", "P.", "Q.", "R.", "S.", "T.", "V." are alphabetical letters, given as lines. Long s is written as s throughout. "Yfucapionibus" and "Vfuris" were transcribed as "Ysucapionibus" and "Usuris" under the u/v rule; the Y and the initial V are read as printed, so these two words are slightly uncertain. Numbers were copied as printed, including the "Tit.16. III." lines.
